notes.text: The Chinese Tunnel Rescue Team is mobilised in Upper Trisuli 3A and is working with the Nepali rescue team. They have opened some parts of the tunnel.

notes.text: Army teams break into the upper part of the mud-swamped Trishuli 3A tunnel.
